title: Here for the Boos Heavy Cotton T-Shirt, Funny Drinking Ghost Halloween Tee, Spooky Season Graphic
description:
A sheet ghost raises a bottle above distressed Here for the Boos lettering in this black-and-white Halloween design. A playful choice for costume parties, fall gatherings, and anyone who enjoys a spirited ghost pun.

PRODUCT FEATURES
• Gildan 5000 Heavy Cotton T-shirt
• Classic unisex fit
• White, 100% cotton
• Medium-weight 180 g/m² fabric
• Tubular construction with no side seams
• Ribbed knit collar and shoulder tape
• Tear-away label
• Sizes S–5XL

FIT AND SIZING
This is a classic-fit shirt, not an oversized or boxy-fit tee. Please review the size chart before ordering. For a roomier fit, consider sizing up one size.

CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Machine wash cold, maximum 30°C or 90°F
• Tumble dry on low heat
• Use non-chlorine bleach only when needed
• Do not iron
• Do not dry clean

PRODUCTION
Each shirt is printed to order. Slight variations in color and print placement may occur between the images shown and the finished garment. Designed by HomeFromWorking and professionally printed and shipped by a production partner.

Artwork for this design was created with the assistance of an AI image-generation tool and arranged into the finished shirt design by HomeFromWorking.
